title: Vendor Contact Verifier input
description: The businesses to check. For each one the Actor reads the business's own website and returns the phone number it finds there, with the pages that prove it. Give it the website_url from your own vendor records, never a link from an email.

businesses.title: Businesses
businesses.description: The businesses to check, each an object with name (how you know the business) and website_url (its own website, a full https:// URL taken from your vendor records). Only pages on the host of each website_url and under its folder are crawled.

maxPagesPerSite.title: Max pages per site
maxPagesPerSite.description: The most pages requested on one website: the homepage, the extra paths and the in-scope links found on the pages (same host, inside the folder). A request that fails (a 404) counts too. Lower it for a quick check.

extraPaths.title: Extra paths
extraPaths.description: Pages to try besides the homepage, written as paths. They are read inside the folder of website_url: for https://host/shop/ the path /contact means https://host/shop/contact. A path that does not exist, or that would leave the folder, is skipped.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: How long to wait for one page before giving up on it. A site that never answers is reported with site_reachable false.
